purpose: Teach: 負わ/乗ら/みせる/欠い/破れ/つっ/貼ら/吐く

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、家計を負わされた、男の役割だった。
lines.en: When I was younger, providing for the household — that was a man's role.
lines.style: Measured, looking back across decades. Quiet certainty in the delivery. No bitterness. Pause after the dash, letting the weight of that expectation settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。私はバスに乗らない時代、自転車だった。
lines.en: Yes. Before I could take the bus, I was on my bicycle.
lines.style: Agreeing gently. Soft, almost tender nostalgia. Not lingering on hardship — just stating the texture of those days. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前の優しさ、孫にみせる時、温かいな。
lines.en: Your kindness, when you show it to the grandchildren — it's so warm.
lines.style: Speaking with real affection, eyes on her as he says it. Deliberate pacing. Tender without being flowery. The honesty of someone who doesn't compliment easily.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の家具、欠いた部分も、味があったわよ。
lines.en: Even the old furniture, the chipped parts — they had their own beauty.
lines.style: Nostalgic, almost wistful. Gentle rhythm. Not mourning what's broken, but acknowledging how damage tells a story. Warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の網戸、破れたから、張り替えよう。
lines.en: The garden screen door is torn. We should re-stretch it.
lines.style: Practical, gentle. Not an order — a quiet suggestion between partners. Calm, matter-of-fact. The tone of someone who sees something that needs doing and mentions it without fuss.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 戸につっかい棒、念のため、入れて寝るのよ。
lines.en: I put a wedge in the door before bed, just to be safe.
lines.style: Simple, grounded in habit. Not anxious — just careful. The matter-of-factness of someone doing what needs doing. A slight pause before 'safe,' like a small nod to her own circumspection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 写真、まだアルバムに貼らない方が、見返しやすいな。
lines.en: The photos, if we don't glue them in yet — they're easier to look back through.
lines.style: Thoughtful, practical wisdom. Slow pace. A gentle logic to it, like he's worked this out quietly over time. Not urgent. The voice of someone who knows when to hold off.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お孫さん、お腹空いて、吐く時もあるって、心配ね。
lines.en: The grandchildren — sometimes when they're hungry, they get sick. It worries me.
lines.style: Quiet concern layered underneath. Not panicked, but genuinely worried. Slower pace. The vulnerability of an older person noticing something fragile and wishing he could fix it. Softness at the end.
